services.name: Tandem skydive
services.desc: Here at Jump Georgia Skydiving, (near Tamp, Augusta, and St Petersburg), you must be 18 years old and you must be less than 230lbs. Parachuting or skydiving is a method of exiting an aircraft and returning to earth with the aid of gravity, then slowing down to the last part of the descent by using a parachute. Tandem jumpers from Augusta and Savannah need not worry if you are tandem skydiving for the first time. All first time jumpers will be attached to our USPA certified trainer. You will only need a five minute training session that will be given by your Tandem Instructors.
